This was my first time visiting Jack Allen’s, and it definitely won’t be my last! We started with the Barbacoa Stackers, and wow they were absolutely fantastic. I was hesitant about the coleslaw on top, but it actually made the dish even better.

The service was phenomenal. Our waitress was so sweet and took the time to walk us through the entire brunch menu. She was attentive, friendly, and really made the experience enjoyable.

I ordered the Breakfast Quesadilla, and it was delicious. The inside was eggs were slightly overcooked and the sauce was packed with flavor without it, the dish might have been a bit bland, but they nailed it. One of my friends got the Chicken and Biscuits, which looked amazing, and another friends had the Fish and Soup, which they said had great flavor.

Overall, the portion sizes were generous for brunch, and everything we tried was full of flavor. Highly recommend giving this place a try!

A family member has been here several times and has talked highly about the food so we thought we’d finally try this location.

We arrived at a about 4 o clock on a Monday so there was very many customers present.

When our waitress came to the table she provided an excellent description of that days specials and when asked provided a good variety of the meals she’d recommend for a first time customer.

We ordered the Texas Coast Crispy Shrimp, Chicken Fried Pork Chop and Pesto Marinated Crab Stuffed Chicken.

For having very few customers at the time we considered it a long wait for our food to come to the table. (Our family member who had recommended this location had boosted about how quick service had been during his visits).

The wait was clearly worth it, the food quality was exceptional.

Didn’t have drinks this time but next time it will be get a drink, chill, have a conversation and wait for the food to arrive. We will return.

I had the fried shrimp and barbacoa enchiladas, and both were full of flavor and cooked just right.

The portions were generous without being overwhelming, and everything tasted fresh. I ended the meal with dessert topped with ice cream, and it was the perfect sweet finish.

Service was very friendly and attentive, and the cozy atmosphere made it an easy spot to relax and enjoy dinner. 10\10 I definitely recommend and will be back 🫶🏾

Amazing Veteran’s Day lunch! We had chicken fried chicken and barbacoa enchiladas. Both were excellent! Tim is an awesome server! Knowledgable about the menu, attentive, personable, and friendly. He rocks! Thank you, Jack Allen’s for honoring veterans! We appreciate the hospitality.

I had my first visit to Jack Allen’s, and I can confidently say it won’t be my last! The staff was so warm and welcoming, and our server really stood out with their knowledge and spot-on recommendations.

We started with the Barbacoa Stacker appetizer—such a perfect combination of flavors. For my entrée, I tried the seasonal Blue Crab Ravioli, which was light yet wonderfully satisfying. And dessert? You absolutely must try the Blondie Pie topped with vanilla ice cream—it was the perfect sweet ending.

What impressed me most was learning that every ingredient is locally sourced, which makes the experience even more special. Next time I have friends visiting from out of town, Jack Allen’s will definitely be at the top of my list to share with them!

**⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Outstanding Experience at Jack Allen's Kitchen!**

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Jack Allen's, and it was truly an exceptional experience from start to finish. The atmosphere is warm, welcoming, and perfectly captures that cozy Texas charm with a touch of sophistication.

The food was the real star—fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with high-quality, locally sourced ingredients. I highly recommend the Breakfast Sandwich Scrambled farm eggs & crispy potato birds nest, applewood smoked bacon & jack cheese, brioche bun, chipotle hollandaise, jalapeno mayo, JAK’d up breakfast potatoes -absolutely delicious! Every bite was bursting with flavor, and the portions were generous without being overwhelming.

Our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and made us feel right at home. The staff overall went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time.

Whether you're visiting for brunch, lunch, or dinner, Jack Allen’s delivers on every level. It's the kind of place you want to return to again and again. Highly recommend!

Came here for my Birthday dinner with my wife. Hutto and Jack Allen knocked it out the park! Hutto built a new lovely space where people can congregate and walk around an amenities pond. Well-lit , has water fountains and is viewable from Jack Allen's patio. Parking is simple thanks to the free, large, covered, and multi-level garage next door.

The food at Jack Allen's was great. I wish there were just a few more seafood/fish options; they only offered one Ruby Trout and two Salmon plates at the time we went. But there was a seasonal short rib and it was amazing. The server was outstanding, the drinks were great and matched her descriptions and recommendations. The food came much faster than expected (granted they were not super busy), and everything looked and tasted great. We live in Pflugerville, but having a nice place in Hutto to go to instead of traveling farther west will be much appreciated!
Food was very good. The redfish with crab and 5 cheese Mac  with chicken were good. The appetizer of pimento cheese was not worth it. Give that a pass.

reviews_data.review_text: I love Lamppost Coffee shop here in downtown Hutto! Their breakfast sandwiches are delicious, and the shop has a cute layout with a cozy, welcoming vibe. Definitely a great spot to grab a bite and relax. I’d highly recommend.

I was in town for a midday meeting, so I decided to get in early to get work done and not need to deal with traffics right before the meeting. I set up at Lamppost which had a nicely sunlit space with tables that had power strips strapped on or placed near outlets. I particularly liked the high ceilings. Staff was very friendly, coffee was solid, and I got to order breakfast and lunch. All solid food and typical coffee shop prices.

I’ve just moved to Hutto, and I love the place, even though there’s very few coffee places nearby (and I love coffee).

This is not the first time at Lampost Coffee, so I thought it’d be worth dropping a review.

Lampost is a small coffeehouse chain with a few stores scattered around. The one in Hutto is located in one of the town’s historic buildings, which is beautiful. It has a great, relaxing environment. Perfect for reading, studying, chatting with friends etc.

The staff are nice, warm and welcoming, although the service can be painfully slow when there’s a bit of a line.

I like Cappuccino’s, but I’ve found theirs to be too milk heavy, so I opt for the Latte, which is creamy and smooth. I only wish they served it a little hotter (will ask next time).

Their breakfast sandwich is very tasty and worth the order. I’ve had it at least 3 times. Always good!

To sum up; tasty food, lovely ambience, amazing building and ok coffee.

I’ll be back.

I had a wonderful experience at Salt and Waves Salon and couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out.

When I originally scheduled my appointment, the stylist assigned to me unfortunately had a family emergency. The salon was very proactive and kind in reaching out ahead of time and gave me the option to reschedule or be double booked with another stylist, Alexis. Since I had an event the very next day, I chose to keep my appointment, and I’m so grateful they were able to accommodate me on such short notice.

Alexis was fantastic. You can tell she is truly dedicated to her craft and genuinely enjoys what she does. She is confident, skilled, and efficient while still being very thorough. Even though she was double booked, I never felt rushed. She is warm, friendly, and easy to talk to, making the experience even more enjoyable. She clearly takes pride in making people feel good about themselves, and it really shows. I also truly appreciated that she honored the original pricing from my scheduled stylist, which was incredibly thoughtful and professional.

The salon itself is beautiful. Clean, welcoming, and well maintained. The wash bowls were hands down the most comfortable I’ve ever experienced, which is such a small detail but made a huge difference. The bathrooms were spotless, and every staff member I encountered was pleasant and welcoming.

I have very long hair, which takes time and care, and Alexis did an amazing job. My hair turned out beautiful, and everything was done in a very timely manner, especially considering the circumstances. The pricing felt fair and appropriate for the amount of work involved.

Overall, I had a great experience and truly appreciate the care, flexibility, and professionalism shown by the entire team. I highly recommend Alexis and Salt and Wave and will absolutely be back again.

The whole staff at Solis Dental made me feel welcome, come and like I was in control. Both Dr Esocabar and Tony (my hygienist) were so patient with me, took so much time to make sure I was comfortable and ensure I knew what was happening and what came next.

I wish I remembered the assistants name who took my X-rays because she was one of the sweetest people I’ve ever met. Even Brandon at the front desk was kind, patient and caring.

The technology they use is top notch and made me feel so comfortable and at ease. I’m so glad I ended up finding Solas Dental. Every single person at this office cares and wants to ensure you are comfortable.

They also offer sedation dentistry which is a BIG deal for me - anything past a normal polish/cleaning and I freak out. They have multiple options available and made me feel confident about next steps

They did the dental work well, so if you don’t mind getting ripped off in more ways than one, I guess this place is great!

But no matter how good the dental work is, there were two reasons why I am giving it one star.

First, the doctor is very charismatic- which can be a good thing, but I don’t believe it is here. He used that charisma to point out how I had cavities all in my mouth while the last place said my dental hygiene is great, barring one glimpse of a developing cavity. I’m not surprised there’s more because it’s been a short time (like a little over a year) since my last cleaning, but given how my dental health has been, it’s not enough for this many problems. Likely, he’s pointing out every tiny issue even if it doesn’t need to be fixed in hopes that I’ll get them done and he can make a bit more money on every one at my expense.

Second, and much more egregious (since you can just say no to fillings) is the fact that they seem to be unable to process insurance. They charged me $130 for the basic work like the cleaning and x-rays, while every place I’ve been to before charged $40 MAX. On the same insurance.
They claimed I had a $50 deductible, which sounded suspicious to me since I have never paid a deductible in the past. After consulting with my insurance, I have a deductible but it does NOT apply to basic cleanings and such, only to fillings or something more.
Worst of all, when I reported their mistake to them, they came back and said “nope, we have it right.” Right after I PERSONALLY SPOKE TO MY INSURANCE.
This will require a lot of work on my side to get my money back (which I am very tempted to demand a full refund for since they have so mistreated me). DO NOT use Solis Dental. They are a money-grabbing corporation disguised behind big smiles so that you will trust them right up until you hand them your money. Find ANYONE else to get care from- it may not look as fancy as what these people have, but at least they should be able to figure out how to charge you for the work. Solis Dental does not deserve one dime of your money.

reviews_data.review_text:
Everything these days isn’t what it used to be. You can create an account online, schedule an appointment, or simply walk in. On this particular day, I decided to walk in.

I was greeted by a nice gentleman to the left—unfortunately, I didn’t catch his name—but he was helpful and got me situated to meet the employee I was there to do business with. I then met Rudy Saquiche, and we discussed several things I was trying to take care of.

Rudy took the time to educate me on my understanding of banking—what was possible and what wasn’t. He also explained how other competitors operate, saying things like, “You might be looking for something like this, but they won’t do that,” or “You could get this over there, but they won’t offer this.” He never spoke negatively about anyone and still presented Chase Bank as a strong and viable option, explaining, “This is who we are as a company, and this is how we do business.”

In the end, I chose to stay with my current bank, but I left with a better understanding of other options that could be useful if I’m ever in a different situation. Well done, Chase Bank team. I may be back in the future.

Christina helped me today figure out what credit card was best for me. She was absolutely amazing and really helped me make a long term plan for what credit card works for me now and what I want in the future. She also helped me figure out how to use my cards to the best of my ability. So friendly and I learned so much. 10/10 recommend to talk to.
First class help at the teller desk.  Very polite and attentive service.  Chase Hutto is the best in the area.

Look, after reading countless negative reviews that talked about how terrible and unhinged this location was, I really needed to check it out for myself. I was prepared to walk into a place that was potentially going to be on fire, be screamed at and maybe also scammed.

Unfortunately, none of that happened. People were nice, polite and efficient. I walked-in asking for an ATM machine (ok so they don’t have one inside) but the teller and welcome team solved my problem instantly. It was frankly disappointing how well-oiled the place was, the reviews had me ready to fight for my life for a withdrawal.

10/10, won’t use again. It’s too normal in there.

⭐☆☆☆☆ Smells like sewer and snobbery

Walked into Chase Bank in Hutto and was immediately hit with the smell of a backed-up sewer. Thought maybe I had walked into the wrong kind of institution — turns out I was right.

I told the girl at the front I was there to open a joint account. My boyfriend already banks here solo, and we were ready to take the relationship (and our finances) to the next level. Unfortunately, Chase wasn’t.

An employee turned us away at 4 PM sharp like she was guarding the gates of Fort Knox. She claimed she was “fully booked” (for what? The smell?), but in the same breath told me appointments aren’t even required. Ma’am, which one is it? Because at this point, I felt like I needed to schedule a meeting with Jesus just to get some customer service.

She also added, “Maybe if you’d walked in earlier…” with a tone that gave “bless your heart” energy — and not the nice kind.

We left without an account… but at least we got a free whiff of what failure smells like.

Worst chase bank every time we have to do anything with the ATM machine it is out of order so we have to drive an extra minutes to do a simple deposit. The ATM has been out of order more days in the year than it actually being in service. The ATM is supposed to be more convenient but it's hardly ever working or being in use. Honestly worse bank don't use it save yourself the time and stress.
People are nice. But the atm is always broken. Lines are slow. They just remodeled 3 months ago but if chase can't fix their atm, get your money out.

I came in to make a wire transfer and have been waiting for over 50 minutes to meet with an advisor. Although there are two advisors present, it appears only one is currently assisting clients. Don’t bother to come to this branch.

I had an extremely frustrating experience at this bank. Despite scheduling an appointment, there was no sense of time management or organization. I waited in the designated waiting area for 15 minutes, but no one acknowledged my presence. When I finally approached the teller area, they acted surprised and mentioned my wait time as if it were normal. By the time I reached them, my total wait had extended to 25 minutes.

To make matters worse, they then told me that since I wasn’t in the waiting area when they checked, they took another customer instead, and I would have to wait even longer. This level of mismanagement and lack of respect for customers’ time is completely unacceptable. If appointments are not honored and customer service is this poor, there’s no point in scheduling one.

I would not recommend this branch unless they make significant improvements in their service and time management.

Horrible experience. We had an appointment for 12:30 with Megan Stiner. They made us wait for 30 minutes to meet her because she was late with her previous client. We finally met her at 1 PM. If you can’t honor the appointment, why do you ask people to make an appointment before coming in?
